author: Alex Kahn
description: Outcome feedback loop for AI agents — typed artifact features + attribution-joined outcome stats + evidence rendering, so an agent's context (not its weights) gets measurably better per user. Experiment variants bolt on.
name: @absolutejs/outcomes

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts src/manifest.ts --outdir dist --root ./src --target=bun && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --project tsconfig.json && absolute-manifest emit
scripts.release: bun run format && bun run test && bun run build && bun publish
